szoveg_eredeti:
I’ve tried the other products in this category myself. Teammates are a notch above everything else. Glad to see that resonate with users. Simple reasons: (1) Harness (efficiently running agent traces largely in code), (2) Model-Neutral (not forcing you into a worse non-frontier model), (3) Quality of Perplexity’s search and accuracy.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Julian Brooks (@OutsourcedLogic); megjelent: 2026-11-08T04:34:41+00:00; link: https://x.com/OutsourcedLogic/status/2119287468151439794; média: nincs média]
Teammates are one of the only agent products to come out recently that are ACTUALLY useful. It all comes down to the orchestrator and I think they really nailed it. Doesn’t overly subscribe subagents, doesn’t give them massive, expensive prompts that confuse them, super easy to manage.

Seriously becoming Perplexity Pilled recently..
